title: Science Corporation implants its vision-restoring chip in its first Stargardt disease patient
hook_text: An implant just restored a patient's vision.
script:
Science Corporation just implanted its PRIMA vision-restoring chip in its first Stargardt disease patient.
Max Hodak, co-founder of Science Corporation and former president of Neuralink, shared the update on October 13, 2026.
Stargardt disease is an inherited genetic condition that causes progressive central vision loss over time.
The subretinal device works with special glasses that project infrared images directly onto the tiny microchip.
This medical trial marks a major step forward in building a practical brain-computer interface.
Would you trust a brain-computer chip in your eye?
